snippet.title: Caput Mortum - Official Launch Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Caput Mortum launch trailer for this first-person horror game. Caput Mortum mainly focuses on exploration, atmosphere, and puzzles, while providing simple combat against monstrous creatures. Caput Mortum is available now on PC.
